class.name: DataValidationOptions
class.description: Passed to [method DataSchema.validate] and [method TextDataFormat.validate]. [code]null[/code] there means the defaults: at most 1000 issues, no lines.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [method TextDataFormat.validate] fills the line of every issue from the text kept by [method TextDataFormat.parse]. Costs one pass over the text; editors turn it on, games usually do not need it.
The most issues kept. Validation stops when the limit is reached. [code]-1[/code] keeps all.
If [code]true[/code], validation stops at the first issue (a quick yes or no).
